facts.business: Quantum Digital Vision (India) Limited is a company incorporated in 1980 with registered office in Mumbai, but the excerpts do not specify its business activities.

auditor.name: Arvind Baid & Associates, Chartered Accountants (FRN 137526W)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern: The Company has accumulated losses of ₹1,453.57 lakhs as at 31 March 2026 and its net worth continues to remain negative. Further, the Company incurred a loss of ₹44.99 lakhs during the year ended 31 March 2026 and its current liabilities exceed current assets as at the balance sheet date. These conditions indicate the existence of a material uncertainty that may cast significant doubt on the Company's ability to continue as a going concern. However, the financial statements have been prepared on a going concern basis for the reasons stated in the said note. Our opinion is not modified in respect of this matter.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to accumulated losses of ₹1,453.57 lakhs, negative net worth, loss of ₹44.99 lakhs during the year, and current liabilities exceeding current assets.
